ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominant; approximately 1:10 ratio of high-intensity (white/gray) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented macro-region covering >90% of fluke area. High-contrast white contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips. Sparse, high-intensity punctate spots (mottling) are distributed across the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3-8 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; distinct jagged peaks at the distal terminal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convexity transitioning to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment points) located at the far-left and far-right distal tips; scattered white circular pockmarks across the left lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal linear white pixel disruption (rake mark or scratch) visible on the left lobe near the median notch; smaller horizontal linear marks on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent textured barnacle colonies at the outer edges of both fluke tips; significant diagonal white linear scar on the inner-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple white ring-like circular marks (circular scars) on the mid-to-upper right lobe.
